caption:
Tuesday's Sky is Yin Wood, The Climbing Vine 🌿 Find your element below.

Your element is the element of the day you were born. Today's climbing vine meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yin Wood gets a friend day, Yin Water gets a joy day, Yin Earth feels the pressure.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which line is too accurate? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #zodiacsigns #selfdiscovery #fiveelements #chineseastrology #astrologyreels #chinesemetaphysics #officelife #knowyourself
day_line: A climbing vine on a Goat day. Gentle and growing: good for teamwork and patient progress, easy to people-please.

lines.Yang Wood: A colleague wants the same slot today. Share the stage; you both win.
lines.Yin Wood: Your allies are close today. Ask for the intro you've been shy about.
lines.Yang Fire: Someone fuels your plan today. Say thank you with something sweet.
lines.Yin Fire: A small clue solves a big puzzle today. Trust what you noticed.
lines.Yang Earth: Your boss sees your patience today. Keep the steady pace; it's working.
lines.Yin Earth: Requests keep growing today. Say no to one, nicely and early.
lines.Yang Metal: Admin day pays off. Clear the claims and file the receipts.
lines.Yin Metal: A small opening appears today. Send the message before you overthink.
lines.Yang Water: You've got the words today. Pitch it at the huddle, short and bright.
lines.Yin Water: Tuesday treats you kindly. Take a proper lunch break outside.
